description: Ministry of Justice Prison Affairs -  Appointment Under the Prisons Ordinance Local Visiting Committees.
categorisation: This gazette notification contains appointments to Local Visiting Committees under the Prisons Ordinance. It specifically involves law enforcement and corrections administration, as it deals with prison oversight committees. While it includes named individuals (which might suggest Type 2), the content primarily concerns judicial/law enforcement matters related to prison administration and oversight committees, making it fall under Type 9 (Judicial/Law Enforcement Gazettes) rather than government personnel changes.
